title: Final Form
description: Form state management with subscription-based rendering.

data.text: Final Form is a high-performance subscription-based form state management library for React.

data.title: Final Form

data.text: Final Form is the framework-agnostic engine under React Final Form. Its distinguishing idea is subscriptions: a field subscribes only to the pieces of form state it renders, so updating one field does not rerender the others. That is what keeps complex forms responsive.

data.title: A React Final Form field

data.text: Validation can be defined per field with `validate`, or for the whole record, or via a schema. `input` and `meta` are handed to a render function, so you decide exactly how each field renders instead of being bound to a component. That flexibility is the reason for the render-prop API.

data.title: Why Final Form still exists
data.text: Its strength is the subscription model, which avoids the rerender cost that a single values object otherwise imposes. The cost is a more verbose render-prop API and a smaller community than React Hook Form. Mention the subscription model as the differentiator rather than describing it as "another form library".
